meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.layout: Per owner's sketch 'Design 2' v2 (2026-10-25): west wall = 600 vanity (window end) | dividing wall | bracket-and-pole hanging system behind bi-fold doors (with a stack of wire baskets) | full-height 'cupboard 2' facing the lobby/WC (towels below, open middle, boxes on top); full-length mirror on the lobby's south wall (on your right as you enter). Queen bed top-right, headboard on the window wall; TV feature wall at the foot of the bed; L-shaped study table behind it (no cabinets below) with wall cabinets above on the east wall; 2 office chairs. Hook rail on the south wall between the study table and the WC door; 34" monitor on the back of the feature wall.
meta.orientation: North = facade/window wall (top of plan). East = facade side wall (right). South = Bath/WC 1 wall with the WC door at x 11950-12650. West = Bedroom 2 wall; lobby + room door to the south-west.
meta.inspiration: Hanging area: open metal wardrobe system (wall standards + brackets, poles, wire shelf, pull-out wire baskets) behind white bi-fold doors, like the owner's reference photos.
meta.note: Product sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm before ordering.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face, assuming 150 mm internal / 200 mm external walls: ~3125 W x 4250 L. Verify on site.

bed.note: Headboard on the window wall, kept to the 900 mm sill. Get in from the left (west) side - ~945 mm aisle to the glass doors.

vanity.note: 600 mm vanity at the window end of the west wall (shared cosmetics): floating top fixed to the walls on three sides, open below for the stool. No drawers, no mirror. Daylight from the window on its left.

partitions.name: Wall between the vanity and the hanging area

pole_closet.note: Not carpentry: wall-mounted standards + brackets holding hanging poles and a wire shelf on top (like the reference photo). Upper pole full length (2040). Window end: lower pole at 1000 for double-hang. Middle: stack of 4 pull-out wire baskets (to ~870) under short hang. Toilet end: long hang.

bifold.note: White free-sliding bi-fold doors: 3 pairs (~337 leaves) on one top track across the hanging area. Each pair folds AND slides to either end and stacks flush there (each folded pair takes ~85 mm of track, sticks out ~340 into the ~945 aisle). Control per pair in Blender: -1 = folded at the window (north) end, 0 = closed, +1 = folded at the toilet (south) end; `position` is the starting state after a rebuild (drawn: pair 1 at the window end, pair 2 closed, pair 3 at the toilet end); `open_to` is where 'Open all' sends each pair.

sections.note: Full height, facing the lobby / WC: towels on shelves below 850, open middle 850-1600, boxes / seldom-used items above 1600.

mirrors.name: Full-length mirror
mirrors.note: Lobby south wall - on your right as you walk in from the room door (clear of the door swing).

feature_wall.note: Full-height timber-slat feature wall (150 thick) at the foot of the bed. TV on the bed side, study table on the other side. Conceals TV cabling.

tv.note: Centred on the bed, on the slat face. ~1.7 m from the pillows, so 50".

l_desk.note: L-shaped study table, no cabinets below: 1625 x 530 along the back of the feature wall + 1550 x 520 along the east wall. Wall cabinets (350 D, 1450 to ceiling) above the east-wall leg. Two office chairs: one facing the feature wall, one facing the east wall.

mbr_hooks.note: hook rail on the south wall

mbr_mirror.note: walking in: full-length mirror on the right

mbr_monitor.note: PRISM+ X340 PRO on its wall arm, from beside the first chair

hook_rail.note: Timber hook rail on the south wall between the end of the study table and the WC door, for towels, bags and clothes. Hooks at 1650.

monitor.note: Per PRISM+ listing: ~810 x 361 mm without stand, 1500R, VESA 100 x 100 (needs custom spacers). Total depth ~132 incl. curve + back housing (listings vary: 72 / 132). Mounted on a VESA wall arm on the back of the feature wall; the included stand is not used. Bottom edge ~150 above the desk.
